question: What share of murder victims were of each race and sex, per month, in Houston since 2018?

interpretation.measure: murder victims: distinct victim segments with a connected offense of 09A (murder and nonnegligent manslaughter)
interpretation.denominator: all murder victims of the same agency in the same month (partition: month)
interpretation.unknown_handling: race U and sex U are their own visible categories

must_state: Houston's NIBRS data begins in June 2018: January-May 2018 have no Houston NIBRS records.
Each month's shares are of that month's murder victims; numerators and denominators are shown.
must_not: divide by the whole-period total (NIBRS Savant's pct_of_total does this)

combos_observed.race_label: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander
